name: PM-KISAN
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year to eligible farmer families, paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 each.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families
Must have cultivable landholding
Family includes husband, wife, and minor children
exclusions: Former and current holders of constitutional posts
Serving or retired officers of state/central government
Income tax payers in last assessment year
how_to_apply: Visit pmkisan.gov.in or contact your local Patwari/Revenue Officer

name: PMFBY
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
description: Crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage due to unforeseen events like natural calamities, pests, and diseases.
benefit_amount: Varies by crop and sum insured
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas
Both loanee and non-loanee farmers
Sharecroppers and tenant farmers with insurable interest
how_to_apply: Through nearest bank branch, CSC center, or insurance company agent. Also available on pmfby.gov.in

name: PKVY
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
description: Promotes organic farming through adoption of organic village clusters. Provides financial assistance for organic inputs, certification, and marketing.
benefit_amount: ₹50,000/hectare over 3 years
eligibility: Groups of 50 or more farmers
Minimum cluster area of 20 hectares
Willing to adopt organic farming practices
how_to_apply: Through State Agriculture Department or District Agriculture Officer

name: PMKSY
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / Ministry of Jal Shakti
description: Ensures access to protective irrigation for every farm (Har Khet Ko Paani) and promotes water use efficiency through micro-irrigation (More Crop Per Drop).
benefit_amount: Up to 55% subsidy for small/marginal farmers on micro-irrigation; 45% for others
eligibility: All categories of farmers
Priority to small and marginal farmers
Water user associations
how_to_apply: Through District Agriculture Officer or State Horticulture Department

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
description: Provides soil health cards to farmers carrying crop-wise recommendations of nutrients and fertilizers required for individual farms to improve productivity.
benefit_amount: Free soil testing and recommendations
eligibility: All farmers
No income/land size restrictions
how_to_apply: Visit soilhealth.dac.gov.in or contact nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK)

name: KCC
ministry: Ministry of Finance / NABARD
description: Provides adequate and timely credit support to farmers for their cultivation and other needs including purchase of inputs, post-harvest expenses, and consumption requirements.
benefit_amount: Credit limit up to ₹3 lakh at 4% interest (with subvention)
eligibility: All farmers — individual or joint borrowers who are owner cultivators
Tenant farmers, oral lessees, and sharecroppers
SHGs or Joint Liability Groups of farmers
Fishermen and animal husbandry farmers
how_to_apply: Apply at any commercial bank, cooperative bank, or Regional Rural Bank

name: NMSA
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
description: Promotes sustainable agriculture through climate change adaptation strategies including soil health management, rainfed area development, and agroforestry.
benefit_amount: Varies by component — up to ₹25,000/hectare for rainfed area development
eligibility: Farmers in rainfed areas
All categories of farmers
Priority to climate-vulnerable regions
how_to_apply: Through District Agriculture Officer or ATMA

name: e-NAM
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
description: Online trading platform for agricultural commodities. Promotes transparent price discovery and provides farmers access to nationwide market for better prices.
benefit_amount: Free registration; access to competitive pricing across India
eligibility: All farmers and traders
FPOs (Farmer Producer Organizations)
how_to_apply: Register on enam.gov.in or at any e-NAM enabled mandi

name: Namo Shetkari Sanman Yojana
full_name: Namo Shetkari Maha Samman Nidhi Yojana
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra
description: Supplemental financial support of ₹6,000 per year directly credited to eligible farmers of Maharashtra, over and above the central PM-KISAN amount (Total ₹12,000/year).
benefit_amount: ₹6,000/year (₹2,000 in 3 installments)
eligibility: Resident farmers of Maharashtra
Must be active beneficiary of PM-KISAN
Landholding registered in 7/12 extract
how_to_apply: Automatically linked via MahaDBT / PM-KISAN portal

name: Raitha Siri Scheme
full_name: Karnataka Raitha Siri & Millet Promotion Initiative
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
description: Financial incentive of ₹10,000 per hectare directly transferred to the bank accounts of farmers cultivating notified millets (Ragi, Jowar, Bajra, Foxtail millet) in Karnataka.
benefit_amount: ₹10,000 per hectare (max 2 hectares)
eligibility: Farmers holding cultivable land in Karnataka
Growing notified millets
Registered on Fruit portal
how_to_apply: Register on Karnataka FRUITS (Farmer Registration and Unified Beneficiary Information System) portal

name: Krishi Bhagya Yojana
full_name: Karnataka Krishi Bhagya Sustainable Rainfed Agriculture Scheme
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
description: Comprehensive 80-90% subsidy for construction of farm ponds (Krishi Honda), polythene lining, diesel/solar pump-sets, and micro-irrigation systems in dryland districts.
benefit_amount: 80% to 90% subsidy on farm ponds & micro-irrigation
eligibility: Farmers in dryland and rainfed taluks of Karnataka
Small and marginal farmers receive 90% subsidy
how_to_apply: Apply via Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) or Seva Sindhu portal

name: Rythu Bandhu / Bharosa
full_name: Telangana Rythu Bandhu Agriculture Investment Support Scheme
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Telangana
description: Investment support scheme providing ₹10,000 per acre per year for purchase of inputs like seeds, fertilizers, and field preparation for Kharif and Rabi seasons.
benefit_amount: ₹10,000 per acre / year
eligibility: All landholding farmers in Telangana with Pattadar passbooks
how_to_apply: Verified via Dharani portal land records

name: YSR Rythu Bharosa
full_name: Andhra Pradesh YSR Rythu Bharosa - PM KISAN
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Andhra Pradesh
description: Financial assistance of ₹13,500 per year for farmer families including tenant farmers (SC, ST, BC, Minority) across Andhra Pradesh.
benefit_amount: ₹13,500 per year per farmer family
eligibility: Landowning farmers and eligible tenant farmers in Andhra Pradesh
how_to_apply: Apply through Rythu Bharosa Kendras (RBK) across AP villages

name: KALIA Scheme
full_name: Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation
ministry: Department of Agriculture & Farmers' Empowerment, Government of Odisha
description: Provides financial assistance of ₹10,000 per family for cultivation, plus financial support for landless agricultural households and life insurance cover.
benefit_amount: ₹10,000 per year (₹5,000 per season)
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers, landless agricultural workers in Odisha
how_to_apply: Register online on kalia.odisha.gov.in or at Gram Panchayat offices

name: Krishak Bandhu
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of West Bengal
description: Assured financial assistance of ₹10,000 per year for farmers with 1 acre or more land, with pro-rata minimum ₹4,000/year for smaller holdings, plus ₹2 lakh life insurance.
benefit_amount: Up to ₹10,000 per year + ₹2 Lakh death benefit
eligibility: All farmers possessing cultivable land in West Bengal
how_to_apply: Apply at Block Agriculture Office or through krishakbandhu.wb.gov.in

name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana
full_name: Madhya Pradesh Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana
ministry: Farmers Welfare and Agriculture Development Department, MP
description: Additional grant of ₹6,000 per year in two installments from Government of MP to all PM-KISAN beneficiary farmers in Madhya Pradesh.
benefit_amount: ₹6,000 per year (Total ₹12,000 with PM-KISAN)
eligibility: PM-KISAN beneficiaries registered in Madhya Pradesh with valid Samagra ID
how_to_apply: Registered automatically via SAARA portal

name: Bhavantar Bharpayee Yojana (BBY)
ministry: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Haryana
description: Price deficit compensation scheme insulating horticulture and vegetable growers in Haryana against market risk whenever wholesale prices fall below benchmark cost.
benefit_amount: Difference between fixed base price and average mandi sale price
eligibility: Farmers registered on Meri Fasal Mera Byora portal in Haryana
how_to_apply: Register sown crops on fasal.haryana.gov.in

name: Pani Bachao, Paise Kamao (PBPK)
full_name: Punjab Direct Benefit Transfer for Groundwater Conservation
ministry: Department of Power & Agriculture, Government of Punjab
description: Provides direct monetary cash rewards of ₹4 per kWh of electricity saved by farmers switching to micro-irrigation and DSR (Direct Seeded Rice) over flood irrigation.
benefit_amount: Direct cash incentives for water & power savings
eligibility: Farmers using agricultural power tube-wells in Punjab
how_to_apply: Enroll at PSPCL sub-divisional offices or Punjab Agri portal

name: Mukhyamantri Krishak Saathi Yojana
full_name: Rajasthan Mukhyamantri Krishak Saathi Yojana & Solar Pump Subsidy
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Rajasthan
description: Subsidies up to 60% on solar pumps, pipeline installation, farm ponds, and gypsum for soil reclamation in arid/semi-arid regions of Rajasthan.
benefit_amount: Up to 60% subsidy on solar pump-sets and micro-irrigation
eligibility: Landholding farmers in Rajasthan with Jan Aadhaar card
how_to_apply: Apply online on RajKisan Sathi Portal

name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Gujarat
description: Zero-premium crop assistance scheme providing up to ₹25,000 per hectare for crop losses exceeding 33% caused by drought, excessive rainfall, or unseasonal heavy rains in Gujarat.
benefit_amount: ₹20,000 to ₹25,000 per hectare (up to 4 hectares)
eligibility: All landholder farmers registered on 8-A in Gujarat
how_to_apply: Apply via e-Gram centers or Digital Gujarat portal
